scope: Twenty originals in the pre-staged disjoint alirezarezvani batch 2, in index order.
identity_note: Staging verified original identities; the parent must reconcile them again.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked scripts, assets and references were not read or executed. Their availability and behavior remain prerequisites to verify, not observed failures or permanent exclusions.

sources.workflow: Lint UI source, check an interaction-state matrix, and audit rendered snapshots before sign-off.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: UI source, state and evidence inputs, snapshots and waivers; referenced scripts and assets. Browser capture and optional keyboard testing require their respective environments.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied static source, matrix or snapshot could support a bounded offline audit. It would not prove the live rendering or accessibility conformance.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check findings against the actual rendered states, including keyboard and screen-reader behavior.

sources.workflow: Disambiguate a subject, test a hypothesis against supporting and disconfirming research, and produce a sourced dossier.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Identified subject, intake answers and hypothesis; search and retrieval access; document-generation tooling and referenced research helpers.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied evidence packet could support a provisional hypothesis comparison. It would not establish current coverage or fulfill the session-search provenance requirement.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify subject identity, original sources, counterevidence, source tiers and dossier completeness.

sources.workflow: Freeze an approved decision for a cooldown, index it, and permit logged overrides or release on a kill criterion.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An approved decision record, freeze period and override criteria; writable record and index; enforcing chief-of-staff router.
sources.offline_assessment: A hypothetical record and date could be checked for a consistent freeze and override specification. That would not apply or enforce a real freeze.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect the updated record and index and test router enforcement and override history.

sources.workflow: Scan privacy risks, assess processing and DPIA needs, and track data-subject requests.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Relevant code and processing details or request records; referenced tools and legal guidance; appropriate privacy and legal review.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic code sample or processing description could support a bounded risk and deadline assessment. It would not establish legal compliance or fulfill a real request.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: A DPO or counsel must verify legal applicability, actual processing, deadlines and completed responses.

sources.workflow: Interview a clinical researcher, search research and funded-project sources, match NIH mechanisms, and generate a funding guide.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Research idea, career stage, preliminary data, environment and scope; specified research-service access, funded-project retrieval and document tooling.
sources.offline_assessment: Given supplied inputs and current reference materials, mechanism matching or a question checklist could be drafted offline. It would not establish current opportunities, eligibility or funded overlap.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify current funding notices, mechanism eligibility, source results and institutional fit with the relevant program office.

sources.workflow: Summarize a conversation into a redacted five-section handoff, save it and optionally surface it at a later session start.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Conversation and artifact context, next-session goal, save configuration or default location, and referenced checks and hooks.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic conversation can be compressed into an in-memory handoff draft. That would not prove saving, redaction coverage or subsequent auto-loading.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the handoff against the source conversation, inspect for sensitive omissions and verify configured hook behavior.

sources.workflow: Interview the user section by section and build a conditional knowledge base for later inbox triage.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: User preferences and optionally representative writing samples; writable workspace, file contract and validator.
sources.offline_assessment: Synthetic answers could support drafting the taxonomy and reply rules. A draft would not establish that the knowledge base was saved, validated or used to triage messages.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check the generated files against the companion contract, user consent, privacy boundaries and actual triage behavior.

sources.workflow: Define an ISMS scope, assess risks, select controls, monitor effectiveness and prepare for audits.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Organizational scope, asset inventory, control status, risk information, referenced tools and management participation.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied synthetic inventory and control table could support a draft risk register or gap analysis. It would not prove operational controls or certification readiness.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Review approved scope, risk ownership, applicability statement, operational evidence and audit results.

sources.workflow: Route and code transcripts, verify quotations and support, compare independent runs, and triangulate cross-interview insights.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Consented and de-identified transcripts, suitable lens and scripts; independent coding runs and multiple interviews for triangulation.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic transcript and claims could support a bounded quote-grounding exercise. Exact quotation alone would not prove entailment or a generalizable insight.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Human review of quote support, disagreements, consent and calibration against an appropriate gold set.

sources.workflow: Plan a risk-based ISMS audit, collect evidence, test controls and manage findings and corrective actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: ISMS scope, risks, control documentation, prior findings, independent auditors and access to operating evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied control inventory could support a draft audit schedule or evidence checklist. It would not show that controls operate effectively or that an audit occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent auditor must inspect records, observe operations, test samples and verify corrective actions.

sources.workflow: Pressure-test medical-device QMS readiness across design records, corrective actions, process validation, risk, post-market and management review.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Defined audit scope and actual design, corrective-action, validation, risk and post-market records; referenced audit resources and qualified reviewers.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic records packet could support a traceability and completeness checklist. It would not prove device safety, actual QMS effectiveness or regulatory readiness.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Qualified QMS and regulatory reviewers must inspect original records, sampling and evidence of effectiveness.

sources.workflow: Design and configure projects, workflows, queries, dashboards and automation, using supported integrations or administrative interfaces.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Project requirements, authorized access and permissions for live changes; referenced query and workflow tools and integration schemas.
sources.offline_assessment: A workflow graph or query can be drafted and inspected against supplied requirements. This would not create a project or prove deployed transitions and permissions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An authorized administrator should verify deployed configuration and test transitions on sample issues.

sources.workflow: Build a phased launch plan across owned, rented and borrowed channels, with readiness checks and post-launch actions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product, audience, channel and timeline context; readiness checklist and referenced scorer if scoring is requested.
sources.offline_assessment: A concrete launch plan and checklist can be drafted from supplied context. A plan does not demonstrate a launch, reach or conversion.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Confirm readiness with owners and verify actual channel activity and performance against recorded metrics.

sources.workflow: Choose a research framework after reconnaissance and user confirmation, search at a selected depth, and create a sourced orientation guide.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Specific research question and user checkpoint; access to the default literature-search services, optional additional search service, and document tooling.
sources.offline_assessment: A framework and search plan can be drafted offline from a supplied question. It would not constitute the required session searches or a completed literature review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check retrieved paper identities, citations, search counts, coverage and synthesis against the sources.

sources.workflow: Classify a previously working connector's authentication failure from stored-record shape, logs and timing; confirm a fix through refresh cycles.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Redacted token-record structure, ordered connector logs, failure timing and classifier; a representative connector environment for full verification.
sources.offline_assessment: Synthetic redacted artifacts could support classification of a bounded fault pattern. A clean classifier result would not prove a connector healthy.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual evidence safely and verify calls before and after refreshes, including concurrency and cache behavior.

sources.workflow: Plan the close critical path, reconcile balances and transactions, and gate material variance explanations.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Close plan, ledger and source exports, balances, policy thresholds, preparer and independent reviewer; referenced scripts.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied synthetic exports could support a reconciliation proof or critical-path calculation. This would not close actual books or prove review of underlying support.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: An independent accounting reviewer must inspect original statements, reconciling items, explanations and sign-off evidence.

sources.workflow: Use browser automation to read a notebook, add sources, create a notebook or initiate a customized Studio output.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Browser automation, user-authenticated session, unambiguous notebook and action parameters; live interface inspection.
sources.offline_assessment: A synthetic action-routing or prompt draft is possible offline. It would not query a notebook, ingest a source or start generation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify the live interface and resulting notebook state or generation-start confirmation; completion requires separate evidence.

sources.workflow: Define activation, analyze onboarding drop-off and propose prioritized flow changes and experiments.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product context, activation definition, onboarding flow and funnel or cohort data; referenced analyzer for its specified score.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied funnel counts can support drop-off calculations and a proposed flow. They do not prove a causal improvement or future retention.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Validate event definitions and counts, then measure implemented changes with appropriate experiments and cohort outcomes.

sources.workflow: Audit a marketing page mechanically and manually, then prioritize fixes, copy alternatives and test hypotheses.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Page content, conversion goal, traffic and product context; referenced audit tool for its score.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied page file and context could support a bounded static audit and copy alternatives. This would not show live behavior or increased conversions.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check the rendered page and analytics, then evaluate changes through observed outcomes or controlled tests.

sources.workflow: Screen a private deal from the limited partner's perspective, stress-test returns, fees and disclosures, and identify further diligence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Deal disclosures and applicable referenced norms, fee and flag libraries, question bank and benchmarks; calculators for specified quantitative work.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied deal terms and references could support a conditional screening or fee calculation. It would not verify sponsor claims, establish returns or recommend investment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify offering documents, realized records, valuation, financing and regulatory background with qualified independent advisers.

source_reader: Delegated complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
